incidents.name: Pawnfi
incidents.notes: ApeStaking.setCollectRate is unprotected; attacker sets it to 100% and drains staked APE via deposit/withdraw loop.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x85018CF6F53c8bbD03c3137E71F4FCa226cDa92C to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x0b89032e2722b103386adccae18b2f5d4986afa0, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (1114692s -> 1113036s)
